messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PROD ALERT — hosted-api-prod (us-east-1) seeing a spike in 5xx during model warmup. Symptoms: repeated model load deserialization errors, and repeated CUDA/cuDNN compile-timeouts causing container restarts. 5xx rate x7, p99 token latency +2s. Auto-retries causing retries -> cascade. Root propagation window started 3757999900 UTC.

maya: i'm on pager, joining. can someone paste the failing log snippet?

jun: grabbing logs from runtime cluster now. which model(s) affected? seen it on several gpt-variants after the deploy.

incident-bot: attached sample lines from node runtime-priv-42: 
```
2026-03-15T21:12:05Z ERROR model_load: deserialize/deser: unexpected EOF reading tensor stream (model: rdx/gpt-medium-2026q1)
2026-03-15T21:12:07Z WARN  cudnn: kernel compile timeout after 120s (arch: sm80)
2026-03-15T21:12:07Z ERROR container: OOM when allocating KV cache during warmup
2026-03-15T21:12:09Z INFO  fallback: routing to variant rdx/gpt-medium-2026q1-quant
```

nanya: this pattern screams compile-cache eviction + concurrent warmups. if multiple nodes try to compile same kernels simultaneously, driver OOMs and we start killing containers. also the deser EOF might be from partial artifact fetch when backing store is under pressure.

sam: can we throttle warmup concurrency and enable variant fallback earlier? suggest: set WARMUP_CONCURRENCY=1, disable eager compile on warmup, increase artifact fetch retries to 5.

jun: doing a quick mitigation. patching runtime config to lower concurrency and increase artifact retries. running: 
```
kubectl -n redwood exec configmap/runtime-config -- 
  --set warmup.concurrency=1 
  --set artifact.fetch.retries=5
# OR using our control plane
rwctl config set --env hosted-api-prod warmup.concurrency=1
```

maya: also scaling up the fallback pool for quantized variants so traffic can shift if load fails.

ops-bot: draining node ip-10-3-12-45 (runtime-priv-42) for investigation. cordon/drain initiated. reason: repeated kernel compile failures + OOMs.

jun: patch completed, warmup concurrency now 1 (confirmed via /admin/runtime/config). starting to see fewer OOM restarts. compiling cache miss rate still high though.

prod-support: customer-impact snapshot: 4 orgs reported elevated error rates in last 10m. one customer (acme-analytics) saw ~3% of requests failing with 502; majority saw latency only. logged customers and notified CS.

maya: good. heap of mitigation tasks next: (1) keep concurrency=1 until deploy can be rolled back or compile cache fix deployed, (2) increase artifact read parallelism limits on storage to reduce partial fetches, (3) add short-circuit to route to quantized variant earlier if warmup fails.

jun: creating quick rollback of the recent runtime deploy (it touched kernel flags). starting canary rollback now.

sam: can someone run a targeted test for model artifact integrity? i want a checksum compare on one failing node: 
```
sha256sum /mnt/artifacts/rdx_gpt_medium_2026q1/model.bin
# compare with central manifest
rwctl artefact verify --id rdx/gpt-medium-2026q1
```

nanya: i'm taking logs & stack traces and will post a short dump to the incident doc. tagging next oncall for overnight: @leo — you'll get handoff in ~20m.

leo: acknowledged. i'll take night watch; do we need to page infra? looks like storage throttling might be a contributor. if artifact store retries failing, that explains partial deserializations.

incident-bot: handoff recorded. paging leo at 3758000200.

maya: quick status — post-mitigation metrics: 5xx reduced to ~1.5x baseline, p99 latency trending down. still seeing intermittent deser errors (1/min). rolling rollback in progress by jun.

jun: rollback completed to prior runtime image (sha: a1b2c3). after rollback, compile timeouts dropped to near-zero. containers stabilized.

prod-support: updating CS: majority impact transient, 4 customers saw issues, one had ~3% failure window for ~12min. tickets opened and seeded with ops notes.

maya: action items for postmortem:
- investigate compile cache eviction policy and ensure global lock/leader for early kernel compile
- artifact store: add read-after-write consistency checks and retries with backoff
- add guard in warmup path to fallback to precompiled/quantized variant faster
- load test multi-node warmup for sm80/autorollbacks

leo: i'll own the nightly follow-up and coordinate with storage infra tomorrow. putting link to runbook and postmortem template: https://redwood.internal/ops/incidents/runbooks/model-warmup-md

maya: thanks team — marking incident as mitigated; leaving thread open for notes. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: incident-mitigation: mitigated -> monitoring. duration: 00:22: (3757999900 -> 3758000122). followup task created: INC-2026-6721 (postmortem)

jun: adding logs + artifact checks to the incident doc now. will post final TL;DR in morning.

maya: handing off to leo.

leo: taking it. i'll follow up with storage team in morning and close action items. :eyes:"
